newsitem.title: USA: Checkfree in 5-yr pact with Wells Fargo.
newsitem.headline: Checkfree in 5-yr pact with Wells Fargo.

text.p: CheckFree Corp said Thursday it has agreed to a five-year contract with Wells Fargo Bank to provide bill payment processing for the bank's customers. Terms of the contract were not disclosed.

The electronic commerce service company said the agreement lets it operate on all of Wells Fargo's existing and planned bill-payment channels, including thebInternet, touch-tone telephone and automated teller machines.
The transition from Wells Fargo to CheckFree processing is expected during the second quarter of 1997, CheckfFree said.
